what: At each spot (bird) in the Section, one accent-colored origami bird is drawn with Lottie, flapping by cycling nine poses at 3 frames each (36fps 27 frames = .75s) repeats endlessly. Birds are hidden at first, then rise one by one from 25px below in .75s power4.inOut. From the second bird on, each starts when the previous one is 80% done (.15s apart). Fires fx:last when the last bird starts rising and fx:done when all have risen. Birds are center-anchored (left · top is the bird’s exact center), so a large bird may hang halfway outside the section

options.on: When — enter (default, once when it comes into view) · load (right on attach)
options.start: Line where enter switches on, default top 75% — in the original About section it is the section head at top 25%
options.delay: First new delay (sec), default 0 — original Hero is .4
options.dur: Duration for one bird to rise (sec), default .75
options.overlap: Overlap share with the front bird, default .8(-=80%) — if 0, each one appears fully before the next
options.y: Distance dropped down before rising (px), default 25
options.ease: Rise curve, default power4.inOut — the original about section uses the default curve power1.out
options.fps: Wing flap speed (frames per second), default 36
options.flap: When off, a bird frozen in its first pose with no flapping
options.--fx-size: One side of the bird (CSS variable, set per bird via element style), default 18vw — the image panel is square so the bird is about 2/3 of it
options.[data-fx-part=bird]: One bird slot — left·top (bird center) and --fx-size set via style, data-key 1~5 gives five poses with different tilt and left-right orientation

note: The original new Lottie (01~05_MV_green) is not used, the motion part draws our own polygon bird with the same frame and frame count. Without lottie-web the bird slot stays empty and only the rise-up plays.

from.where: index.html .wb-cover .wb-bird (six birds on the hero — original Cover b1~b6: fromTo opacity 0·y 25 → 1·0 .75s Power4.easeInOut, b1 delay 1 + -=80%, the rest [2,3,6,4,5] -=80%) · .wb-verse__stage .wb-bird (About section a_b0~a_b5 — same type at #about top 25%, default curve, last a_b4 onStart plays the Rive text)
